note: MDC access on the South Fabius River west of Newark (no boat ramp). Camping is on or beside the one small gravel lot, about 17 x 23 m, at the end of a 200 m unimproved gravel lane off Tumble Weed Avenue; nothing built (no pads, tables, toilets or water) and room for one or two rigs. No unattended open campfires. The river is about 60 m east through bottomland timber, out of sight. --Claude
summary: Designated camping point (map symbol + GIS point) at the only lot, and the brochure allows camping 'on or adjacent to all graveled area parking lots' - stays under the designated-point rule but is a single tiny lot: owner's call. Phone matches. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands. Pin fine.
flags: LOT RULE - BORDERLINE, READ AS STAYS: the page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' and 'Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey)'. Brochure (12/2021): 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all graveled area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed.' and 'Walk-in camping is allowed year round EXCEPT during all firearms deer and turkey seasons. During these seasons camping is only allowed on or adjacent to graveled area parking lots.' The 12/10/2021 map draws a camping symbol right beside the single 'P' (its legend lists only Parking Lot, not the camping symbol), and GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 39.99986,-92.02396, on the south edge of the lot (15 m from the lot's GIS point). So MDC does mark a designated camping point at the lot - which keeps it under the 2026-11-09 rule (as Lick Creek) - but the brochure's wording is the 'camping in the parking lot' kind that dropped Cross Timbers and Locust Creek, and on imagery there is nothing but the lot: a gravel pad about 17 x 23 m where the lane ends against the woods. If the owner reads brochure wording as outranking the map symbol, this is a drop.
FIRES: 'No unattended open campfires allowed' (brochure) - in the note.

ACCESS: Tumble Weed Avenue (gravel county road) 1 mile north from Highway 156, then about 200 m east on a lane the map legend calls 'MDC Unimproved Road'; on imagery it is an ordinary single-lane gravel track along a field edge. No ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording.

FLOODING: the lot is at the edge of the upland fields at the top of the wooded slope (map contours 680 ft at the lot against 650-660 ft along the river), so it is above the bottom; nothing on the page or brochure mentions flooding or a closure.
WATERFRONT - NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: the South Fabius (15-20 m wide, sandbars) is about 60 m east and downslope through closed timber; nothing seen of it leaf-on.
PIN: stored pin = the GIS camping point, on the lot's south edge. No move.
PHONE: stored 573-248-2530 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 248-2530'.
No split (one lot, 160 acres). Nothing else in the database within 3 km.
